item.title: Loudoun County Board of Supervisors votes against putting SROs in elementary schools
item.description: The Loudoun County Board of Supervisors has decided against funding school resource officers for elementary schools — for now. In a 3-2-1 vote, the Loudoun County Board of Supervisors moved not to fund SRO’s at elementary schools across the district. Instead, another motion was placed to add five school resource officers and a seargent to help backfill when officers are called to elementary schools.
